summary:
- Rename Felaris to Veluno with a new logo and Windows icons.
- Keep existing profiles, saved tabs, bookmarks, and default-browser links during upgrades.
- Speed up local search suggestions and rank obvious site and tab matches first.
- Smooth search, sidebar, tab, and loading animations, including interrupted transitions.
- Remember dismissed update notices and show download progress.
- Preserve source pages and unsaved drafts when links start downloads.
- Deliver the Windows installer directly in Discord release announcements.
